title: Authenticated FFI resource creation plan cache
objective: Cache authenticated immutable dynamic FFI owned-resource creation plans and prove fail-closed metadata identity with neutral resource tests and measured cross-resource speedups

handoff.summary: Adds a closure-private, immutable owned-resource creation plan cache keyed by authenticated declaration identity. Repeated calls reuse backend exports, exception/lifecycle policy, and parameter marshalling kinds; every supplied metadata field is compared exactly and drift fails closed before backend work. A neutral real-FLINT 5x50000 local comparison reduced median FmpzPolynomial create+close from 10.493us to 9.567us (8.8%) and FmpqMatrix from 9.252us to 8.422us (9.0%). Focused FFI tests, strict baselib, full build, and architecture checks pass.
risks: The cache is process-global by declaration identity, so a malformed first internal declaration fails during plan construction and later metadata drift remains intentionally fail-closed.
The portable tier reached batch 5/6 but failed an unrelated Chromium group-Wasm test because dist/wasi-runtime.mjs returned 404; the focused runtime/FFI suite is green.
next_steps: Integration should rerun test:portable after producing the expected browser wasi-runtime.mjs artifact.

This generic cache does not close the rational QQ public-add gate: the accepted direct owned-result floor remains above 2x Magma, and the ordinary 256-bit scalar-vs-Magma gate still lacks a durable equal-contract receipt.
